# Parse the old songs list into a list of (title, artists) tuples.
content = old_songs_file['content']
old_songs = []
for line in content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        if ' by ' in line:
            title, artist_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
            old_songs.append((title.strip(), artists))
print(old_songs)
